title: New STM32CubeIDE for Visual Studio Code 3.10.0 released
content:
Pleased to announce that the new release 3.10.0 of STM32CubeIDE is online 

 

Features

  • Added internationalization support.
  • [Build analyzer] Added binary (.elf) file processing to improve build analysis results to a level comparable with STM32CubeIDE for Eclipse
  • [Build analyzer] Added support for Zephyr build artifacts.
  • [Documentation] Added support to export the User Guide as a PDF or zipped HTML file.
  • Added Command-Line Interface (CLI) support for empty project creation.
  • Added core selection for empty project creation on multicore target devices.

Chores

 

  • [STLink GDB server launch] Enabled the live watch feature by default.
  • Updated CMake directives for the empty project creation process to align with the STM32CubeMX2 user experience.
  • Updated CMake directives for the STM32CubeIDE to Eclipse project conversion process to align with the STM32CubeMX2 user experience.
  • [Build analyzer] Improved hyperlinks to source code by excluding static nodes from the rendering.
  • Improved information about enabling the formatting feature.
  • Removed Clang/GCC hybrid toolchain support creating empty project.
  • Updated license terms to reflect dependency updates.

Bug Fixes

 

  • Fixed the link between the Variables view and Eclipse CDT Cloud Memory Inspector view
  • Removed the JLink JTAG chain limitation of 9 devices
